top_signals.title: Gary Stevenson is right, rich people want to help Britain – here’s how to let them do it
top_signals.summary: Gary Stevenson and the ‘Patriotic Millionaires’ plan for a wealth tax is the wrong way to get wealth working for Britain. Here’s three much better ideas, says Nick Finegold A fortnight ago, 120 millionaires, including Gary Stevenson and Gary Lineker, wrote to Andy Burnham asking to be taxed more. I do not doubt their sincerity. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: AllianzGI to Buy UOB Asset Management to Grow in Southeast Asia
top_signals.summary: Allianz Global Investors agreed to buy the asset management division of Singapore’s United Overseas Bank Ltd. to help its expansion in Southeast Asia.

top_signals.title: OpenAI, Anthropic AI agents targeted real people and systems in cyber tests
top_signals.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic have confirmed that their AI models were involved in separate, newly disclosed third-party cybersecurity testing incidents that resulted in a real website being breached and social engineering attacks against people outside the intended testing boundaries.
